spanish: Y tomará para pecar la casa dos pájaros, y madera de erez y carmesí y ezov.

findings.issue: Piel infinitive with the house as direct object is rendered as “pecar”, the qal sense of committing sin, so the stem force on the house is changed.
Common noun ארז is left as the Hebrew form “erez” rather than Spanish.
The construct “scarlet of worm” is reduced to “carmesí”, and the worm noun is omitted.
Common noun אֵזֹב is left as the Hebrew form “ezov” rather than Spanish.

notes: The conjunction, 3ms sequential perfect, article, dual “two”, and birds match the tokens.
